purpose: A bounded viewport whose content scrolls inside a panel, menu or card, with overlay ScrollBars and an optional fade at the scroll end.

notFor.case: Scrolling the whole page: let the page scroll natively.
Paging through a long result set.
A scrollbar placed on its own.

Default.visual: Viewport on Surface/layer-1 with a Border/default stroke (Stroke/control); with FadeVisible, a fade into Surface/layer-1 at the scroll end. The ScrollBars follow its Size and Appearance.

a11y.role: None of its own (Radix ScrollArea); the viewport takes an aria-label when it holds primary content.
a11y.keyboard: The viewport is focusable and scrolls with the arrow keys, PageUp / PageDown and Home / End; the bars are not focusable.

openQuestions: The fade sits at the scroll end: should it hide once the end is reached, or stay drawn?
